sn28.10:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Sāriputto Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn28.10:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahe piṇḍāya pāvisi ||
sn28.10:1.3: Rājagahe sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā taṃ piṇḍapātam aññataraṃ kuḍḍam nissāya paribhuñjati || || 3
sn28.10:1.4: Atha kho Sucimukhī paribbājikā yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || || 4
sn28.10:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho samaṇa adhomukho bhuñjasīti || ||
sn28.10:3.1: Kiṃ nu samaṇa Adhomukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno Na khvāhaṃ bhagini adhomukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi ||
sn28.10:3.2: tena hi samaṇa Ubbhamukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno Na khvāham bhagini ubbhamukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi
sn28.10:3.3: ||tena hi samaṇa Disāmukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno Na khvāham bhagini disāmukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi ||
sn28.10:3.4: tena hi samaṇa Vidisāmukho bhuñjasīti iti puṭṭho samāno Na khvāham bhagini vidisāmukho bhuñjāmīti vadesi || ||
sn28.10:4.2: Ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā vatthuvijjā tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikam kappenti || ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā adhomukhā bhuñjantīti || || 10
sn28.10:4.3: Ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā nakkhattavijjā tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikam kappenti || ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā ubbhamukhā bhuñjantīti || || 11
sn28.10:4.4: Ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā dūteyyapahīṇagamanānuyogā micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti || ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā disāmukhā bhuñjantīti || || 12
sn28.10:4.5: Ye hi keci bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā aṅgavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti || ime vuccanti bhagini samaṇabrāhmaṇā vidisāmukhā bhuñjantīti || || 13
sn28.10:5.1: So khvāhaṃ bhagini na vatthuvijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi || na nakkhattavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi || na dūteyyapahiṇagamanānuyogamicchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi || na aṅgavijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappemi || ||
sn28.10:6.1: Atha kho Sucimukhī paribbājikā Rājagahe rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakam upasaṅkamitvā evam ārocesi ||
sn28.10:6.4: detha samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyāṇam piṇḍan ti || || Sāriputta-saṃyuttaṃ || ||
sn28.10:7.6: Dasamaṃ Sucimudhī cāti || || 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Tatra -- voca -- || 3
